facts.text: The decision under review is the authority's grant of building consent BC240410 under section 72 for building work on slippage-prone land.
Around August 2024 the owners applied for a building consent with ground testing and analysis from a geotechnical engineer.
The owners' property is an elevated site; Figure 3 shows the mass-movement zones on the property.
An in-ground swimming pool is being constructed under clause 23 of Schedule 1, outside this building work.
The owners contest the likelihood of the natural hazard and believe adequate provision has been made.
